edits.before: No new ult — press the early lead; scaling supports are waking up behind you.
edits.after: His level 6 R (The Quickness) charm into a guaranteed W knockup flips the all-in his way — your root rarely sticks long enough to peel it.

edits.before: First item: RQ chunks and RE engages — convert to plates and picks now.
edits.after: With mobility boots and first item he roams and flanks constantly; his engage range and E dash to allies outpace your first-item poke value.

edits.before: Late Karma enables: RE the engage, tether the diver, RQ the sieges.
edits.after: His engage range, E resets and roam pressure dictate fights now — peel your ADC with RE and disengage rather than duel.

edits.before: RQ the carry at wave contact, tether the answer, walk — the chip leads the lane's ledger.
edits.after: Inspire (E) shields the caught ally the instant W lands — cast it before his Q proc-heal offsets your poke.

edits.before: Spending mantra on a wave while the enemy banks theirs for your face.
edits.after: Rakan sustains through chip via Gleaming Quill (Q) proc healing — hold Grievous Wounds for extended trades, not just burst windows.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your RE shield-speed answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Grand Entrance is down 14s early, 10s at max rank — the leap knockup starts every play; track him in fog, the E extends it. - Your RE shield-speed answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
